tips.text: Start the 3 missions as soon as you see a part; invasions can end within a day.
Wait for the server to roll a part invasion; invasions are the same for everyone and nothing you do changes the odds.
Check invasions daily in the Navigation or on the companion app, which lists them without logging in.
Filter invasions by reward, not planet; the shared Wraith and Vandal pool means several parts can be live at once.
Expect the reward only after the invasion ends; a contested one can flip between sides for days.
Players call it slow rather than hard; the Receiver in particular can go weeks without showing up.
